flashcard_questions.q: The process of modifying the genome of an organism by introducing a gene from another organism to produce a desired characteristic.
The entire set of genetic material (DNA) in an organism.
Biological molecules (enzymes) that cut DNA at specific sequences, used to isolate genes in genetic engineering.

flashcard_questions.a: A carrier used to transfer a gene into a target cell, usually a bacterial plasmid or a virus.
A small circular piece of DNA found in bacteria, separate from the main chromosome, used as a vector in genetic engineering.
